assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is indicated.
The service is supported by the documented clinical indication.
The payer's denial under Reason Code PR-204 that this service is not covered.
